content.text:
This endpoint can be accessed by sending a POST request to the `/items` endpoint with a JSON body containing the required fields. The `created_at` field is automatically populated with the current time.

Example Request:

```
POST /items HTTP/1.1
Content-Type: application/json

{
    "id": 1,
    "description": "This is a description",
    "name": "Item 1",
    "rate": 4.5,
    "created_at": "2023-02-20 14:30:00"
}
```

Example Response:

```
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Type: application/json

{
    "id": 1,
    "description": "This is a description",
    "name": "Item 1",
    "rate": 4.5,
    "created_at": "2023-02-20 14:30:00"
}
```
